# sketch-wireframe

> Express a client website's structure (pages, what goes where, the data model) as a hand-drawn sketch that is a real clickable site, and publish it as a capability URL.

Agents: use the MCP endpoint at /mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, JSON responses) or the CLI (scripts/do.ts in the repo).
Start with the tool `describe_format`, then `get_example`. `check_sketch` is free and needs no credential.
Publishing and everything that touches stored sketches is on /admin/mcp (Cloudflare Access service token).

## Pages
- /s/<code>.<key> — a published sketch (the key in the path is the only gate; wrong code and wrong key look the same)
- /s/<code>.<key>/sketch.json — the sketch's data (what the engine renders)
- #/_model inside a sketch — the data-structure diagram and the CRUD back office (no link from the sketch itself)

## MCP tools
open (/mcp): describe_format, get_example, check_sketch
admin (/admin/mcp): publish_sketch, list_sketches, get_sketch, sketch_versions, rollback_sketch, remove_sketch, rotate_key
